description.value: You spend enough time moving around in swamps that they don't slow you down, and you've grown accustomed to having to keep an eye out while inhabiting those swamps. You ignore difficult terrain due to water and mud. You can see twice as far in murky water as a normal creature would, and you can see as far in clear water as you would be able to in air.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
